headline: Anthropic reports a production inference-verification prototype and signed internal token traffic
summary: Anthropic’s Oct 19 Frontier Safety Roadmap says it built a prototype running on production inference that checks whether outputs come from a specified set of model weights. The company also says it rolled out signing on all internal token traffic and that this caught one extremely rare, benign integrity glitch. This is a provider-reported technical milestone; the public page gives no verifier design, scope, detection performance, glitch details or independent evaluation.
